definitions: A species of parasitic protozoan that can cause cryptosporidiosis, an intestinal illness.
A microscopic parasite that lives in the intestine of infected humans and animals and is passed in the stool.
examples: Contaminated water sources can spread Cryptosporidium parvum.
Symptoms of infection with Cryptosporidium parvum include diarrhea and abdominal cramps.
Cryptosporidium parvum is resistant to chlorine disinfection.
